Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks dejected after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、しょんぼりしている。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> était abattu(e) après avoir échoué la mission.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> die Aufgabe nicht geschafft hatte, war sie niedergeschlagen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se veía desanimada después de fallar la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia desanimada.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดูหงอยไปหลังจากทำภารกิจไม่สำเร็จ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terlihat patah semangat setelah gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trông rất ủ rũ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन में असफल होने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> हताश हो गया।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Don't worry. You'll do better next time!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 大丈夫、次は上手くやればいいさ！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 没关系，下次做好就行啦！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 沒關係，下次做好就行啦！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ça ira, tu feras mieux la prochaine fois !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Kein Problem, beim nächsten Mal klappt's!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: No te preocupes, ¡la próxima vez lo harás mejor!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่เป็นไร ไว้คราวหน้าเอาใหม่!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Tidak apa-apa, kamu bisa melakukannya lain kali!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Không sao, lần sau làm tốt hơn là được!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: कोई बात नहीं। अगली बार अच्छा करना!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Il remet une Potion de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบยาเพิ่มพลังให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa ra một Bình Thuốc Sức Sống.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> perked up at the mention of a next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は次という言葉に、元気を取り戻したようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 听到「下次」这个词之后，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>重新振作了起来。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 聽到「下次」這個詞之後，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>重新振作了起來。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Avec l'évocation d'une prochaine fois, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retrouvé ses forces.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> munterte sich auf, als sie „nächstes Mal“ hörte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó al escuchar la palabra "próxima vez".
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou ao ouvir a menção de uma próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>มีกำลังใจขึ้นมาเมื่อได้ยินคำว่า 'ครั้งหน้า'
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> kembali bersemangat setelah mendengar kata 'lain kali'.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> phấn chấn hẳn lên khi nghe nhắc đến lần tới.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: अगली बार का नाम सुनते ही <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> उत्साहित हो गया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 충격이 컸는지, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 한동안 풀이 죽어 있었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> must've taken it pretty hard, because she stayed down for a while.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: かなりショックだったのか、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はしばらくの間しょんぼりしていた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 似乎是因为打击太大，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>消沉了好一阵子。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 似乎是因為打擊太大，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>消沉了好一陣子。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Puisque l'impact a été fort, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est resté(e) abattu(e) un moment.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> muss es ziemlich mitgenommen haben, denn sie war eine Weile niedergeschlagen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Parece que el shock fue grande, pues <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> estuvo decaído/a por un tiempo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Parece que a surpresa foi grande, então <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ficou desanimado por um tempo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: คงจะตกใจมาก เพราะ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ซึมไปพักใหญ่เลย
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Karena keterkejutannya besar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak murung untuk sementara waktu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Bị sốc nặng, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ủ rũ một thời gian.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: शायद उसे बहुत सदमा लगा था, क्योंकि <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> कुछ देर तक हताश रहा।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayé(e) après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ร่าเริงขึ้นมาหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ trở lại sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
